dataset: MNQ 2026 only; original NQ and sealed 2025 never opened
split_policy: 18:00 America/New_York futures-session boundaries; final Monday partial session disclosed
event_purge: Remove training/development labels whose recorded teacher exit reaches the next boundary minus 60 minutes; also purge every feature row in that last 60 minutes. Oracle exit used for purge only.
label_timing: Imitate oracle direction timestamp aligned to feature candle START, but features are available only at its END and entry is NEXT open: a delayed imitation task, not prediction at teacher entry time.
negative_coverage: Wait labels only between first and last exported teacher entry; completeness of exported trade coverage remains an assumption.

models.logistic: StandardScaler fit on training only; LogisticRegression C=1, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=1000

selection: Highest validation net at $4 all-in modeled round trip among at least 20 trades; ties choose lower turnover then lexical name; no-trade is an eligible zero-net alternative. Freeze all selections before final replay. No final-based tuning or retraining.
momentum: Sign of past 8-bar return normalized by ATR, enter only if absolute value >=1; fixed bracket exit

alma.alignment: UTC multiples of eight minutes; complete contiguous buckets only
alma.signal: ALMA close versus ALMA open crossover, only completed HTF values for causal variant
alma.limitation: Offset, sigma, anchor and exact private Pine semantics are not provided; this is an explicitly specified surrogate, not exact Pine reproduction. A matched lookahead-on surrogate is diagnostic oracle-only.

execution: One MNQ contract, $2/point, 0.25 tick. Next observed CONTIGUOUS minute open only; signals cancelled across missing bars. Stop first if both touched; adverse stop gaps at open, favorable target gaps capped at target. Time exits at completed close. No fabricated fills across closures. Open gap exposure marked unresolved and valued at next observed open, not known before gap. Final position liquidated at last observed close. No same-bar reentry after exit. Entries with zero-volume fill bars cancelled.
teacher_reference: Uploaded teacher P&L is hindsight reference only, with incomplete Yahoo matches and no tradability claim. Oracle timing on same feed can be replayed with non-oracle exits as a separately labeled noncausal benchmark.
promotion: None: short sample, uncertain timestamp/contract roll, no independent provenance. No automatic real trading.
publication: Public: code, tests, aggregate reports and hashes only. Private: raw data, row-level predictions, fills, serialized models and full audit. No Pine source published.
